beats.say: This Indian island is three times closer to the Maldives than to Kerala.
beats.cap: 3x closer to the Maldives than to Kerala

beats.say: It's Minicoy, at the southern tip of Lakshadweep.
beats.cap: Minicoy · southern tip of Lakshadweep, India's coral atolls

beats.say: Kochi, in Kerala, is three hundred and ninety-eight kilometres away.
The Maldives begin about one hundred and thirty kilometres south.
Why? Lakshadweep's islands run south, and Minicoy is the last.
beats.cap: The last island in the chain

beats.say: The Nine Degree Channel cuts it off from the rest.
beats.cap: Cut off by the Nine Degree Channel

beats.say: Other islands speak Malayalam. Minicoy speaks Mahl, like the Maldives.
A sea border agreed in nineteen seventy-six keeps Minicoy on India's side.
So it's Indian, yet three times closer to the Maldives.
